decision.title: Kissin' Cousins
tracklist: Anyone (Could Fall in Love with You)

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (12 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kissin'_Cousins_(soundtrack), https://www.discogs.com/release/2476804-Elvis-Presley-Kissin-Cousins. Original LP RCA Victor LPM/LSP 2894 (Apr 1964), 12 tracks. DUPLICATE TITLE: 'Kissin' Cousins' appears twice — track 1 is 'Kissin' Cousins (Number 2)' (the film's opening version) and track 10 is the single version 'Kissin' Cousins'. Tracks 11-12 ('Echoes of Love', '(It's a) Long Lonely Highway') are bonus tracks not in the film; 'Anyone (Could Fall in Love with You)' was also omitted from the film.
